en: Reduce the sidebar Account, Archive, Settings and Check for updates labels from 15px to 12px. Preserve their icons, spacing and click targets.
Show and copy the live MCP OAuth sign-in URL while the CLI waits, so authorization can continue when the browser does not open. Links are cleared when the operation ends.
zh: 侧栏“账号、归档、设置、检查更新”字号由 15px 调整为 12px，保留图标、间距和点击区域。
MCP 登录等待期间显示并支持复制实际授权网址，浏览器未弹出时可手动打开；操作结束后清除链接。
